title: Executive Assistant
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Contract
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are working on behalf of our client, a highly respected local authority organisation, to recruit an Executive Assistant for a 3 month initial duration, with the possibility of extending further.

The successful candidate will provide a proactive, professional, and confidential PA support to the departmental Commissioner and Director, ensuring effective diary and inbox management, efficient coordination of business activities, and high-quality administrative support to enable the delivery of key priorities and objectives.

Key Responsibilities for the Executive Assistant:
- Provide comprehensive administrative and personal assistant support to the Commissioner and Director
- Manage complex and dynamic diaries, prioritising appointments, resolving scheduling conflicts, and ensuring effective use of their time.
- Monitor and manage inboxes, triaging correspondence, drafting routine responses, highlighting urgent matters, and ensuring actions are progressed within agreed timescales.
- Act as a first point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, handling enquiries professionally and escalating issues where appropriate.
- Arrange and coordinate meetings, workshops, and events, including scheduling, venue arrangements, preparation of papers, and circulation of agendas.
- Support the preparation of briefing materials, presentations, reports, and correspondence to a high standard and within deadlines.
- Maintain accurate records, action logs, and filing systems, ensuring information is managed in accordance with organisational policies and procedures.
- Track actions arising from meetings and support follow-up activity to ensure timely completion.
- Liaise with colleagues across the organisation and with external partners to facilitate effective communication and coordination.

Candidate Requirements for the Executive Assistant:
- Previous experience in a similar role providing PA support at Executive level
- Excellent IT skills
- Strong verbal and written communication skills

Unfortunately due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. Please assume that if you do not hear from us within 72 hours that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Recruitment Resourcer / Administrator
company: Lynx Employment Services Ltd - Agency - Temporary
description:
Location: Sheffield (Office Based) Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday Contract: Temporary 3 months (with potential to be extended) Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Lynx Employment Services has been connecting great people with great employers since 2001. Due to increased demand, we're looking for a Temporary Recruitment Resourcer / Administrator to join our friendly, busy team in Sheffield.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same. You'll support our recruitment consultants by sourcing candidates, managing compliance, speaking to applicants and clients, and ensuring vacancies are filled quickly and efficiently.

Key Responsibilities
- Sourcing and screening candidates for temporary and permanent vacancies.
- Advertising jobs across multiple job boards and social media platforms.
- Conducting telephone interviews and candidate registrations.
- Arranging interviews and booking candidates into assignments.
- Processing references, right to work checks and DBS applications.
- Maintaining accurate records on our recruitment database.
- Liaising with clients and candidates throughout the recruitment process.
- Providing general administration support to the recruitment team.
- Assisting with compliance documentation and onboarding.

About You

We're looking for someone who:

Has previous recruitment, resourcing or administration experience (preferred but not essential). Is confident speaking to people on the telephone. Has excellent organisational skills and attention to detail. Can work at pace and manage multiple tasks. Has good IT skills, including Microsoft Office. Is proactive, positive and enjoys working as part of a team. Delivers excellent customer service and communicates professionally.

What We Offer

A supportive and friendly working environment. Full training on our systems and processes. The opportunity to gain valuable recruitment experience across a range of sectors including engineering, manufacturing, public sector, legal and business support. Potential for the assignment to be extended for the right person.

If you're organised, enjoy working with people and want to join a well-established recruitment business, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations Administrator
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are working on behalf of our client, a highly successfully and rapidly growing software developer, to recruit an Operations Administrator for their Sheffield city centre office.

This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys organisation, problem solving and helping a busy and growing business run efficiently. The Operations Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across the business. The role combines office and front-of-house coordination with travel, logistics, purchasing, stock and equipment administration, facilities support and general business administration.

The role works across different teams and priorities, so the successful candidate will be comfortable taking initiative, responding to changing requirements and providing practical support wherever needed. As the business continues to evolve, the scope of the role may also develop. Responsibilities will therefore vary according to operational requirements while remaining aligned with the overall purpose of the position.

Key Responsibilities for the Operations Administrator

Office, Reception & General Administration
- Provide a professional and welcoming first point of contact for visitors, clients and suppliers.
- Coordinate reception, deliveries, meeting rooms and visitor refreshments.
- Support diary coordination, meetings and general office arrangements.
- Coordinate stationery, office supplies and consumables.
- Provide general administrative support across departments and project teams.
- Respond to day-to-day internal and external administrative enquiries and ensure requests are appropriately handled or directed.
- Maintain accurate records, documentation and information within relevant business systems.

Travel & Accommodation
- Coordinate UK and international travel and accommodation as for employees, engineers and project teams.
- Support relationships with hotels, travel providers and other relevant suppliers.
- Ensure appropriate invoices, receipts and supporting documentation are obtained and maintained.

Operational & Logistics Support
- Support the coordination of couriers, shipments, equipment, samples and other operational materials.
- Prepare and maintain appropriate documentation associated with dispatches and deliveries.
- Liaise with courier providers, suppliers and colleagues to resolve day-to-day logistical issues.

Stock & Equipment Administration
- Support the coordination of stock, equipment and operational supplies across business locations.
- Maintain accurate stock and equipment records within relevant business systems.
- Support appropriate identification, storage and traceability of stock and equipment.
- Coordinate replenishment and availability of PPE, hardware, consumables and other operational equipment.
- Support the ongoing improvement of stock and equipment administration processes.

Purchasing & Supplier Support
- Provide administrative support for purchasing and procurement activities.
- Coordinate orders for office, operational and project requirements.
- Liaise with suppliers and service providers regarding orders, availability and administrative queries.

Finance & Business Administration
- Support the processing and organisation of invoices, receipts, expenses and other finance-related documentation.
- Maintain accurate customer, supplier and operational information within relevant business systems.

Facilities & Office Support
- Support the day-to-day organisation and upkeep of the Sheffield city centre office.
- Assist with facilities maintenance and coordination with external service providers.
- Support relevant office health and safety administration.
- Coordinate routine facilities activities and checks where appropriate.
- Assist with the organisation, storage and administration of office IT equipment and other business equipment.
- Help ensure office, meeting and communal areas remain safe, organised and appropriately equipped.

Candidate Requirements for the Operations Adminsitrator

Essential

Previous experience in an administrative, office coordination or similar support role.

Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Confident using Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel and Word.

Comfortable learning and working across different business systems.

Able to work independently whilst supporting colleagues across different teams.

Professional, approachable and service-focused.

Proactive and practical approach to solving day-to-day issues.

Able to use initiative and respond positively to changing business priorities.

Comfortable working across a varied range of administrative and operational responsibilities.

Desirable

Experience coordinating business travel and accommodation.

Experience supporting logistics, couriers or shipping activities.

Experience with stock control, inventory or equipment administration.

Experience supporting purchasing, procurement or supplier administration.

Experience supporting finance administration.

Experience using CRM, finance, workforce management or other business administration systems.

Experience supporting facilities or health and safety administration.

Experience working within an engineering, manufacturing or technology environment.

This is an outstanding organisation to work with and the successful candidate will enjoy being part of a positive, dynamic and forward thinking team culture.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Service Coordinator
description:
Transport Service Coordinator

Salary: Competitive salary with an annual performance bonus (15%) plus Veolia benefits and pension

Hours: Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week 8:30am - 5pm

Location: Beighton, S20 1 AH

When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.
We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.

What we can offer you;
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Stream - Employee financial well being support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & rewards
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full
- potential

What you'll be doing;
- Day-to-day management of service delivery, including the dynamic allocation of work to vehicles/routes
- Communicating with customers and stakeholders, providing status updates and maintaining contact with drivers
- Completing debriefs with front line staff and reporting necessary actions or updates as required
- Face-to-face engagement with drivers, supporting them to address any issues on route
- Reporting of all safety concerns or container damage and encouraging 'stop the job' if it is deemed unsafe to continue
- Ensuring Veolia legal compliance on-site (WTD, O'licence and transport compliance)

What we're looking for;

Essential
- Able to demonstrate an understanding of transport compliance and WTD
- Good communication skills communicating with people of all levels including drivers, frontline employees and customers
- Ability to organise a busy workload and operate at a fast pace Working with a quality management system e.g. ISO Managing transport compliance. Experienced IT Skills, and the ability to adapt to Google operating systems

Desirable
- Previous experience operating within a similar industry; waste/transport/logistics

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Call Centre Operator - Uncapped Commission
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Sheffield team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Sheffield contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Service Desk Analyst
description:
Service Desk Analyst

Location: South Yorkshire

Contract: Initial 3 Month Contract

Working Pattern: Full Time, On Site

We are currently supporting an NHS organisation in South Yorkshire with the recruitment of a Service Desk Analyst on an initial 3 month contract.

You'll join a busy IT team providing frontline support to staff across the organisation, acting as a first point of contact for technical issues and service requests. This role is fully on site and would suit someone with previous NHS or public sector experience who is comfortable working in a fast paced support environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide first line IT support via phone, email and ticketing system
- Log, update and resolve incidents and service requests in line with agreed service levels
- Support users with hardware, software, account access and connectivity issues
- Escalate more complex issues to relevant support teams where required
- Assist with laptop and desktop deployments, builds and device swaps
- Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook and Teams
- Maintain accurate records of all support activity
- Deliver a high level of customer service to clinical and non clinical staff

Essential Experience
- Previous experience working in an IT Service Desk or Helpdesk environment
- Experience supporting Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365
- Experience using an ITSM or ticket management system
- Strong troubleshooting and problem solving skills
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Ability to prioritise and manage a busy workload

Desirable Experience
- Previous NHS experience
- Knowledge of Active Directory and user account administration
- Understanding of ITIL principles
- Experience supporting hardware deployments and device rollouts

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established NHS digital team and provide vital support to users across the organisation on an initial 3 month engagement.

title: Production Administrator
description:
Hours: Monday to Thursday 8am 5pm Friday 8am 4.30pm

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and detail-focused Production Administrator to join our client's engineering business based in Doncaster. This is a key role acting as the vital link between the production and planning teams, ensuring smooth day-to-day operations through accurate administration, reporting, and communication.

The ideal candidate will have strong Excel skills, excellent attention to detail, and the confidence to raise issues, track delays, and keep all relevant stakeholders informed.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the central point of contact between the production and planning teams, ensuring clear and consistent communication
- Provide regular updates on production progress, schedules, and any changes affecting output
- Support production forecasting, helping to track and predict workload and capacity
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records across all production administration tasks
- Raise issues, delays, and discrepancies promptly to the relevant teams
- Prepare and distribute reports on production performance, delays, and KPIs
- Liaise closely with the planning team to align schedules and resolve conflicts
- Support general administrative duties across the production department
- Maintain and update spreadsheets, trackers, and databases with a high level of accuracy
- Flag any risks to production timelines and escalate where necessary

Skills & Experience Required
- Strong Excel skills confident using formulas, spreadsheets, and data tracking tools (essential)
- Excellent administrative skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
- Clear and confident communicator, comfortable liaising between different teams
- Ability to work proactively, spotting and raising issues before they escalate
- Experience in a production, manufacturing, or engineering environment is desirable but not essential
- Comfortable working with reporting and forecasting data

About you
- Reliable, proactive, and a strong team player
- Calm under pressure with the ability to problem-solve
- Confident raising concerns and communicating delays or issues clearly
- A genuine interest in supporting an efficient, well-run production operation

- Liaise closely with the planning team to align schedules and resolve conflicts
- Support general administrative duties across the production department
- Maintain and update spreadsheets, trackers, and databases with a high level of accuracy
- Flag any risks to production timelines and escalate where necessary

Skills & Experience Required
- Strong Excel skills - confident using formulas, spreadsheets, and data tracking tools (essential)
- Excellent administrative skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
- Clear and confident communicator, comfortable liaising between different teams
- Ability to work proactively, spotting and raising issues before they escalate
- Experience in a production, manufacturing, or engineering environment is desirable but not essential
- Comfortable working with reporting and forecasting data

About you
- Reliable, proactive, and a strong team player
- Calm under pressure with the ability to problem-solve
- Confident raising concerns and communicating delays or issues clearly
- A genuine interest in supporting an efficient, well-run production operation

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Commercial Office Administrator
description:
Commercial Office Administrator
Part-Time 25 hours per week, Monday-Friday Permanent Onsite Rotherham £18,667 per annum

Elevation Recruitment Group are delighted to be recruiting for a Commercial Office Administrator to join a supportive and growing business based in Rotherham. This is a fantastic opportunity for an organised and proactive administrator looking to build their career in a varied commercial environment. The role would suit a recent graduate or someone with previous office-based experience who enjoys working across different areas of a business and building strong relationships with colleagues and customers.

Working closely with the Commercial, Finance, Engineering and Operations teams, you'll provide essential administrative support while gaining valuable exposure to commercial processes, customer service, finance and business operations.

As Commercial Office Administrator, you'll play an important role in keeping the day-to-day running of the business organised and efficient.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing incoming calls, emails, correspondence, meetings, calendars and filing systems
- Preparing and formatting reports, spreadsheets, presentations and business documentation
- Providing a high level of customer service, including responding to enquiries, providing order updates and resolving queries
- Supporting the commercial team with spare parts quotations, quotation tracking and KPI reporting
- Assisting with order book reporting, including gross and net order book data
- Processing purchase orders, invoices and expenses
- Maintaining accurate records and updating CRM and internal systems
- Supporting reporting and data analysis to help monitor business performance
- Coordinating office requirements, including supplies, travel and accommodation
- Liaising with external providers, including maintenance and IT support
- Maintaining accurate document control and records to support compliance and audits
- Supporting export documentation, with training provided where required
- Maintaining confidentiality and following company procedures and data protection requirements
- Working collaboratively across departments to ensure a smooth and professional service

We're looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Confident communicating with customers and colleagues
- Able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Proactive and comfortable working independently
- Customer-focused with a professional approach
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook
- Keen to learn and develop within a commercial environment

Previous experience within an administrative, commercial or office-based role would be beneficial but is not essential.

Experience with Sage or similar accounting software would be advantageous, as would exposure to export documentation. Full training will be provided.

What's On Offer?
- Permanent, part-time position working 25 hours Monday-Friday
- £18,667 per annum
- Onsite role based in Rotherham
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Varied role with exposure to multiple areas of the business
- Ongoing training and development
- Opportunity to build a long-term career within a growing organisation
- Interview Date: Tuesday 1 September - onsite.

If you're an organised and enthusiastic administrator looking for a varied role where you can develop your skills and make a real contribution, we'd love to hear from you.

For more information, please contact Amy Wood or Sarah Larkin at Elevation Recruitment Group.

title: Administration Assistant
description: Market Surgery is a friendly, well-established GP practice in Wath upon Dearne, and we're looking for an organised and reliable Administration Assistant to join our busy admin team. This is a varied, hands-on role right at the heart of the practice. You'll keep patient records accurate and up to date, process recalls, manage our inboxes and Accurx, sort and scan post, handle telephone enquiries and provide day-to-day administrative support to the whole practice team. No two days are quite the same, and the work you do directly supports the care our patients receive. You don't need previous healthcare experience to apply we'll give you full training on SystmOne and our systems. What matters most is that you're a confident communicator, comfortable with IT, calm under pressure and happy working as part of a supportive team. In return, we offer a welcoming team, a permanent full-time position, membership of the NHS Pension Scheme, and the genuine satisfaction of doing work that matters to your local community. Please be aware that if you are a registered patient of Market Surgery you will need to change GP providers if appointed As part of our friendly administration team, you'll provide the day-to-day support that keeps the practice running smoothly and our patient records accurate and up to date. Your main duties will include: Inputting and coding data onto SystmOne Processing patient recalls so people are invited in for the right checks at the right time Managing the practice inboxes and Accurx admin messages Opening, sorting and scanning post, and actioning documents appropriately Handling telephone enquiries from patients and other stakeholders Preparing forms, invoices and Subject Access Requests for processing Sorting, filing and retrieving patient records ready for summarising You'll work closely with colleagues right across the practice, so accuracy, organisation and good communication really matter. Full training on our systems will be provided, so you don't need prior healthcare experience to thrive in the role. Job Summary To provide administrative support within the administration team and to all members of the practice team. Ensuring that all information is recorded in appropriate clinical systems. Support duties will include inputting data, care record management, recall processing, scanning, handling telephone enquiries, email management and post sorting. Job Duties & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities Culling and sorting patient records and letters in preparation for summarising. Opening and sorting post. Managing and maintaining the practices email inboxes. Managing the practices accurx system for admin. Scanning post/documents and actioning accordingly. Processing forms. Digitalisation of clinical records. Preparing invoices for forms/requests from. Filing and retrieving paperwork. Retrieve and re-file records as requested, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to. Ensure correspondence, reports, results etc. are stored or filed in correct records. Ensure records are kept neat and tidy and in good repair with all necessary. information recorded correctly on the outer cover where applicable. Provide administrative support to members of the primary health care team in the following areas ensuring appropriate practice records are kept up to date o Billing and invoices (payable to the Practice) o Forms/medical examination requests o Prepare Subject Access Requests for processing. Ensure that patients are invited for clinical intervention and assessment as per the practice recall systems Other Responsibilities Personal/Professional Development The post-holder will participate in any training programme implemented by the Practice as part of this employment, such training to include: Participation in an annual performance review, including taking responsibility for maintaining a record of own personal and/or professional development Assume responsibility for ensuring mandatory training is completed in a timely manner Taking responsibility for own development, learning and performance and demonstrating skills and activities to others who are undertaking similar work Support the development of others to maximise potential Actively promote the workplace as a learning environment, encouraging everyone to learn from each other and from external good practice Participate in implementing change Contribute and participate in the development of local guidelines, protocols and standards Participate in the engagement of practice-based commissioning or similar initiatives Keep up to date with new developments locally and nationally identifying those that will enhance the teams work Prioritise own workload and ensure effective time-management strategies are embedded in own practice

title: Receptionist
description: Be the first friendly face our patients meet. As a Medical Receptionist you're the welcoming voice on the phone and the reassuring smile at the desk guiding people to the right care and keeping the practice running smoothly. No two days are the same. You'll book appointments, process repeat prescriptions, navigate patients to the right service and support our clinical team behind the scenes. It's varied, people-focused work that makes a real difference in your community. Why join us? We're a supportive, close-knit team who look after each other as well as our patients. You'll get proper training, the chance to grow your skills, and the satisfaction of knowing your work matters. This permanent role is 27.5 hours across 5 days at £12.71 per hour ideal if you're organised, warm and calm under pressure. No medical experience needed just a caring attitude and a willingness to learn. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you. Please be aware that this role is 5 days per week Monday to Friday. Shift patterns are 07:45-13:15 and 13:00-18:30. If you are a registered patient of Market Surgery, you will be required to change to another GP Practice As the first point of contact for patients, you'll keep the front of house running answering calls, greeting visitors and making sure everyone reaches the right person or service. Alongside this sits a mix of behind-the-scenes admin that keeps the practice ticking: managing the appointment diary, handling prescription and record requests, and providing clerical support to the wider team. You'll also help patients get the most from digital tools like the NHS App, and work closely with colleagues across the practice to keep communication flowing. In short: a busy, varied front-line role that blends people skills with organisation and attention to detail. JOB SUMMARY The purpose of the role is to: Offer general assistance to the Practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Navigate patients to the appropriate care service. Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice, including the provision of clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice team. Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care and other associated healthcare agencies. JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the Practice Reception team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Reception Team Leader, dependent on current and evolving Practice workload and staffing levels: Opening up/locking-up of Practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with Practice protocols Monitor practice emails Manage timely completion of tasks for the attention of reception teams Registration and deduction of patients from the Practice Register Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing telephone, online and face-to-face requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations, ensuring patients are directed to the appropriate healthcare professionals Care navigation to external care providers Filing and retrieving paperwork Processing repeat prescriptions in accordance with Practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Providing clerical assistance, including word/data processing, filing, photocopying and scanning Keeping the reception area, noticeboards and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Promote patient uptake of online consultation tools Promote patient uptake of the NHS App Process receipt/delivery of patient samples and vaccinations in line with cold chain policies

title: Administrative Assistant
company: Sheffield Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust

description: Provide administrative assistance to the Stroke Pathway Assessment and Rehabilitation Centre based at Beech Hill Rehabilitation Unit . To ensure efficient and effective support to the services. To be the first point of contact for patients and visitors entering SPARC, and to always present a professional and friendly manner. To consistently deliver a patient focused service, which provides good customer service and effective working relationships along the Stroke Pathway. To work closely with the other members of the team to ensure the smooth running of the services at all times. To provide a strictly confidential administrative service to the Stroke Pathway Assessment and Rehabilitation Centre (SPARC), Community Stroke Service (CSS) and Intermediate Care Beds (ICB). To be competent in the use of Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel and PowerPoint as well as Trust systems including SystmOne and Lorenzo. To be responsible for ordering supplies using the in-house ordering system (Integra/Web Basket). To provide administrative support to the Interface office as part of the SPARC/ICB service as required, accurately inputting data into Excel spreadsheets and SystmOne. To cover main reception at SPARC as required - meeting and greeting patients and visitors to SPARC in a friendly and courteous manner and direct all visitors as appropriate. To ensure correspondence, both paper and electronic, is handled and responded to in a timely and efficient manner. To be conversant in the use of the internet and STH intranet, using both effectively to support the work of the service. To positively contribute to team culture and act as a positive ambassador for the organisation. Infection prevention and control is integral to this post. The post holder should, at all times, demonstrate effective infection control and hygiene. When completing your application please ensure that you clearly demonstrate how you meet the role criteria.

title: Receptionist
company: Sheffield Health Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Sheffield Health Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust
description: The Sheffield Adult Autism Neurodevelopmental Service is based at Lyndhurst Road.(SAANS) which provides assessment ,diagnosis and multi-disciplinary interventions with an Autistic Spectrum Disorder(ASD) (including disorders formerly known as Asperger's Syndrome) and associated neurodevelopmental disorders including Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) SAANS also provides a national assessment and diagnostic service as well as follow-up appointments and counselling subject to funding by the clients local Clinical Commissioning Group. Sheffield Health Partnership University NHS Foundation Trust is currently unable to provide sponsorship for this role. This is in accordance with UKVI guidelines and legislation, as these roles do not meet the skill nor salary threshold for sponsorship. If you hold a visa which allows you to work in the UK, you are welcome to apply for this role however our policy requires you to have at least 12 months on your visa at commencement of your employment for training and operational reasons. This means that you need at least 15 months right to work in the UK at the point of application to enable employment checks to be undertaken. Please be advised this post has a cap and will close once this is reached. The Receptionist role will work as part of a team of administrators to provide an efficient and friendly service to all patients and visitors attending the base. We are looking for an experienced receptionist or administrator to perform all allocated administration tasks required to meet the needs of the service and to contribute to the smooth running of the office by providing effective administrative support for the SAANs Service. The candidate should posses' good organisational skills and be able to ensure the professional image of the department and Trust is maintained at all times. Flexibility and the ability to work well under pressure are also essential. Undertake reception duties as appropriate, including dealing with the public over the telephone and face to face. To maintain patients records and appointments to a high degree of confidentiality. To clearly communicate orally with members of the public where there may be barriers of understanding. To undertake typing and produce documents as appropriate, using PC based word processing, spreadsheets, and data-based packages. To undertake general office duties including filing, document control, document scanning and photocopying. To process all incoming and outgoing mail including emails. To process booking courses and workshops offered by the service. To provide administration support for courses and workshops, collating materials and preparing registers. To provide relief cover for other members of the administration team as appropriate. Maintain accurate level of all stationery and stock. To facilitate room bookings for clinicians and staff as required. Assist in the closure of the building on behalf of all teams.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We are a very busy two site GP surgery. We are looking to recruit a Receptionist/ Administrator for 29 hours per week on a 12 month, fixed-term contract, with the view of the successful applicant becoming a permanent member of the team on a part time basis, following the 12 month period. The hours will be based across both of our sites. Typical shifts will be discussed at interview but we require flexibility to cover sickness and holidays to ensure business continuity. We are looking for an enthusiastic person, keen to work as part of a friendly team. You should enjoy working in a busy and challenging environment and have good customer service and IT skills. Knowledge of SystmOne and working in a healthcare setting is desirable but not essential. Please see the job description and person specification for more details. The successful applicant will need to have an outgoing and enthusiastic personality, confident to work on the reception front desk and to communicate over the telephone. flexibility is required to meet the needs of the organisation, be IT literate and have a desire to grow and succeed within the organisational structure. Be interested in people and wanting to help and provide a professional service to our patients. The candidate should be able to work under pressure and be able to deal with stressful situation and to demonstrate conflict resolution. A background in a related reception/administrative role would be useful but is not essential, but a desire to learn is a must. Training will be provided to the successful candidate. The purpose of the role is to: Offer general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Undertake a variety of administrative duties to assist in the smooth running of the Practice including the provision of clerical support to clinical staff and other members of the Practice team Facilitate effective communication between patients, members of the primary health care team, secondary care, and other associated healthcare agencies. Duties and Responsibilities: The duties and responsibilities to be undertaken by members of the Practice Reception & Administration team may include any or all of the items in the following list. Duties may be varied from time to time under the direction of the Reception Team Leader/ Management team, dependent on current and evolving Practice workload and staffing levels: Monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing in person and telephone requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional Processing and distributing incoming (and outgoing) mail Taking messages and passing on information Filing and retrieving paperwork Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required Providing clerical assistance to Practice Staff as required from time to time, including data processing, filing, and photocopying Provision of refreshments for staff and visitors as required, keeping the kitchen area clean and tidy Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and up to date and free from obstructions and clutter Scanning of Practice Mail Preparation of lab requests for Phlebotomy Assisting in the recall processes Returning temporary resident/immediately necessary forms to HA after they have expired Processing and taking action on patient notes (PNs posted on clinical computer system) Opening up/locking-up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with practice protocols Processing and preparation of prescriptions for patients for signature and authorisation by GPs Dealing with queries relating to prescriptions General housekeeping Attending practice meetings Completing statutory and mandatory learning
